newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers supported by cargo strength.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers supported by cargo strength.

text.p: Singapore bunker levels on Thursday were steady to firm on traders' perception that cargo prices would rise later in the day.
Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $97-98 and around $102-$104 per tonne for 180-cst supplies, little changed from Wednesday's levels.
"I expect some firm bids to come into the cargo market later," said one independent. "That could help push bunker levels."
But most traders said that supplies in the prompt market is adequate to meet demand. -- Singapore Newsroom (+65-870 3082)
